title: SISO Agent Stack community adoption baseline

license.reason: The distribution source is MIT licensed; pinned components retain their own licenses.

evidence.summary: The MIT license resolves at the exact release commit.

addressable.reason: The public GitHub release and source are pinned to an exact commit.

archive_downloadable.reason: A commit-scoped source archive is recorded.

evidence.summary: The immutable archive locator resolves from the public repository.

manifest_resolvable.reason: The manifest pins ten components and the release exposes its own plan and doctor command.

evidence.summary: Manifest verification passed with ten components and nine portable surface classes.

installable.reason: The isolated clean-install suite passed twice idempotently and doctor verifies the installed distribution command.

evidence.summary: Eight tests passed, including clean install, receipt tampering, dirty pins, collision safety, privacy scanning, and distribution-command alteration.

forkable.reason: The public MIT source includes explicit contribution and component-ownership routes.

evidence.summary: The contribution contract routes changes to the distribution, Skills, Playbook, Hooks, components, or Great Library owner.

portable.reason: The Claude Code and Codex isolated-home path is verified on macOS; independent Linux, Windows, optional Python, and Herdr provisioning evidence remains incomplete.

evidence.summary: The release improves portable operation without expanding the previously verified host matrix.
The public release adds the managed siso-stack command, adoption/update/rollback documentation, contribution routing, GitHub topics and homepage, and passes all repository checks.
